text: {"lessons":["Selling after sharp losses and then buying Stock B back higher showed me that reactive trading can lock in losses and undermine a plan; I should decide in advance what would change my view.","A few months of account gains or losses are not enough to judge a strategy. I should assess performance over a longer horizon and compare it with the overall market.","I should base each buy, sell, or hold decision on the stock’s prospects and my portfolio risk—not merely my average cost or a desire to recover past losses."]}
